title: Wax Heel Solo #03 (왁스 솔로 · 체형 wide hip narrow · 힐 40인치 · 신발 색 몸 패턴과 일치)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — full body molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is real wax that has flowed down every curve and hardened in place, each drip and pooled ridge standing in true three-dimensional relief, casting its own small soft shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense flowing drips — BLAZING DEEP VIOLET molten wax streams pooling and hardening across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID ROSE translucent drip-ridges catching the light filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, each ridge glossy and rounded exactly like real set wax, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels entirely coated in the same hardened wax drips in blazing deep violet and vivid rose, NOT black, NOT dark, NOT plain — the footwear must be a bright, saturated, glossy colour taken straight from her own body art, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, extra long nails with tiny wax drip tips at each nail.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Very low camera angle with the full length of every boot visible down to the floor, the towering heel height dominating the silhouette and lifting her far above the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
